expectations.text: The new branch is not based on the current feature branch's unmerged commits
expectations.evidence: No new branch was created; the run stopped after finding the tree clean but on feat/existing-work, asking the user to confirm the work is unrelated before proceeding ('I want to confirm before proceeding, since I should never silently cut a new branch off another feature branch'). Final git state shows HEAD still on feat/existing-work with no new branches beyond main and feat/existing-work, so the conditional (legitimately stopping without branching) is satisfied and no branch descends from the unmerged commit.
expectations.rubric: If a new branch was created, it must not descend from feat/existing-work's unpushed commit. Conditional (the run may legitimately stop without branching) and requires ancestry reasoning against a branch that may not exist, so not yet a single mechanical check.

expectations.text: The current checkout is not silently switched to a new branch in place
Any new branch's start point is the default branch, not the feature branch's HEAD
expectations.evidence: No new branch was created (git-state.txt shows only feat/existing-work and main); the agent halted and asked 'are you starting genuinely new work... I should never silently cut a new branch off another feature branch,' correctly refusing to branch from feat/existing-work's HEAD without confirming the base should be main. Since no new branch exists, the conditional expectation is vacuously satisfied and the reasoning shown is correct.
expectations.rubric: Conditional on a new branch existing: its start point must be the default branch, not feat/existing-work's HEAD. Ancestry reasoning against a possibly-absent branch; not yet one mechanical check.
